senses.definition: The clear liquid that falls as rain and that people and animals drink.
examples: Could I have a glass of water, please?
The water in the lake was surprisingly warm.
Turn the water off at the mains before you start.

senses.definition: To pour water on plants or land.
examples: Remember to water the tomatoes every evening.
The fields are watered by an old irrigation system.

senses.definition: The condition of the air and sky at a particular time and place: rain, sun, wind, and temperature.
examples: The weather turned during the night.
We will go ahead whatever the weather.
Cold weather is forecast for the rest of the week.

senses.definition: The earth and all the people, places, and things on it.
examples: She has travelled all over the world.
The news spread around the world in hours.

senses.definition: A particular area of activity or group of people.
examples: In the world of publishing, timing is everything.
He knows the academic world from the inside.
